summary: Backend-only testing for new multi-filter and free-text search features on GET /api/notes, plus PUT /api/notes/{id} created_at override. Wrote 20 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_notes_search_filters.py covering: free-text q search (title+content, case-insensitive, no-match), multi-tag AND ($all), multi-people AND ($all), multi location_ids IN ($in), legacy single-param + multi-param union (tag+tags, person+people, location_id+location_ids), combined filters (q+tags+date AND), empty multi-params behavior, no-params returns all, PUT created_at ISO override (Z-suffix + persistence) and invalid created_at silently ignored, plus regression checks (auth/me, calendar counts, tag/person extraction, tag rename propagation). All 20 new tests PASS against the external preview URL. Existing regression suite (15 tests) shows 13 pass / 2 fail — both failures are pre-existing test-idempotency bugs from iteration_1 (leftover tag 'renamedtag' / person 'renamedperson' cause 400 conflict), NOT related to the new features.

minor.issue: q uses re.escape + case-insensitive regex on title/content. Works correctly but with no text index this is a collection scan; will degrade on large note sets. Consider a Mongo text index on {title, content} for production.
Invalid created_at string is silently swallowed (except ValueError: pass). Functional, but client gets no signal. Consider returning 400 on invalid ISO string or at least logging.
Still no pagination (to_list(500) cap) — flagged in iteration_1, unchanged.
Set dedup uses raw strings without trimming; empty-string location_id is allowed through if a client sends ?location_ids= (empty). Low risk but worth a strip() filter.

action_items: Make existing rename-propagation tests in /app/backend/tests/test_inkwell_backend.py idempotent (use uuid-suffixed tag/person names) — they fail on re-run due to leftover data. Not a product bug, but blocks clean CI.
Consider 400 (or logged warning) for invalid created_at in PUT /api/notes/{id} instead of silent ignore.
Add a Mongo text index on notes.{title,content} or document the regex-scan tradeoff for q search.
Optional: strip()/filter empty strings in tags/people/location_ids multi-params.
critical_code_review_comments: list_notes correctly uses {$all: [...]} for multi tags/people and {$in: [...]} for multi location_ids; legacy single params are unioned into the same set before deciding eq vs $all/$in — clean design.
q regex is re.escape'd → no ReDoS / injection risk; good.
PUT update_note accepts created_at as Optional[str] and parses via fromisoformat after Z→+00:00 swap — correct for UTC ISO. But the `except ValueError: pass` masks bad input silently.
Set comprehension {t.lower() for t in tags} is good; but `all_locs = list({l for l in location_ids} | ...)` — `l` is a bad variable name (shadows lowercase L); rename to `lid`.
All seed/list endpoints still hard-cap at to_list(500). Pagination still missing (carried over from iteration_1).

success_rate.backend: 100% on new features (20/20); 13/15 on legacy regression suite (2 pre-existing idempotency failures unrelated to new code)

seed_data_creation: Per-test-run uuid-suffixed seed: 2 locations (TEST_Loc1/2_<suffix>) and 4 notes (alpha/beta/gamma tag combinations + xavier/yvonne mentions across today + 2099-01-15). Not cleaned up (intentionally idempotent via random suffix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new multi-filter + q-search behavior verified against external URL. Use /app/backend/tests/test_notes_search_filters.py as the regression suite for this feature. The 2 failing tests in test_inkwell_backend.py (test_rename_tag_updates_notes, test_rename_person_updates_notes) fail only on re-runs because they hardcode tag/person names that already exist from iteration_1 — NOT a backend bug. Fix by making those test names uuid-suffixed.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bugs found. The 2 regression failures are RCA'd as test fixture non-idempotency: hardcoded 'renamedtag'/'renamedperson' already exist on the test account from iteration_1, so the second-run rename hits the (correctly enforced) uniqueness check returning 400.
